verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents its own per-project alerts with frequency-of-errors thresholds, delivered by email to team members or to a webhook URL, so the core of the story (per-project rules with a frequency threshold, email routing) exists natively. Much of the story as written is unevidenced: there is no routing by environment or severity, no Slack or PagerDuty destinations, and no new-issue or affected-user-count triggers. missing for 10: environment- and severity-based routing, native Slack and PagerDuty destinations, affected-user-count thresholds, explicit new-issue rule type, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can route alerts by project, environment, and severity to Slack, PagerDuty, or email with per-rule thresholds — new issue, frequency spike, affected-user count

citations.quote: Here you can specify when you want to receive alerts based on the frequency of errors.
By default, new project alerts send emails to a project's team members, but you can also add a webhook URL by clicking “Add An Alert Recipient.”
Teams are for making sure the right people get notified when an error is reported.
